observation.prompt: Read only the current facts and question, using the statute only to understand which factual roles may matter. Use the actual native query to identify the queried person and calendar year, never as evidence that the clause applies. Return every coherent source-native payment/service view. Each payment record must preserve literal payer, payee, amount, the worker and employer of the linked service, the stated service kind, inclusive service endpoints, and an exact payment date only when the case expressly supplies one. A service period is not a payment date. Keep a distinct service event and payment event; do not put people or amounts into event-type roles, duplicate records, total wages, allocate a cross-year amount, infer wages from silence, apply a threshold, or decide employer status. Use complete only after the finite current case has been read; an expressly unstated payment date is null, whereas unread or ambiguous extraction is unread. Complete records and complete finite absence require nonempty verbatim current facts/question witnesses.

Read only factual statements in the current facts and question. Use the actual native query only to identify the queried individual, taxable year, and requested numeric limit; do not assert the queried section. Return every coherent view containing: each stated annual income; each explicit positive or negative section 151(b) or 151(c) allowance given with exactly taxpayer, spouse/dependent, and taxpayer year in that direction; and each relevant marriage state. Preserve polarity—'not entitled' is only a negative given and must never also become positive. Represent 'has/have been married since D' as ongoing_since, a bare commencement as onset_only, and a bounded marriage as closed_interval. Do not invent a same-day end, repeat records, derive an allowance from kinship, use the native label, or decide the deduction limit. Complete means the finite supplied case was read; [] then means no matching statement, while null/unread means extraction was not completed. Complete records or complete absence require nonempty verbatim current witnesses.

Extract only current-case marriage and death facts needed to describe the queried taxpayer's spouse-death chronology. Use the actual native query only to identify the taxpayer and taxable year; do not assert surviving-spouse status. Preserve both spouses on each marriage event and the deceased person and actual death date on each death event. Represent continuing wording such as 'have been married since D' as ongoing_since, a bare commencement as onset_only, and an expressly bounded marriage as closed_interval. Never turn D into a same-day end or extend onset_only into a permanent state. Do not compute the two-year window or decide the clause. Return every coherent view. Complete means the finite supplied case was read; [] is completed source absence, while null/unread is unresolved extraction. Every complete record or complete absence needs nonempty verbatim current facts/question witnesses.

Extract a source-only factual view for the current student-service task. Use the actual native query only to identify the service, employer, employee, student, institution role, and workday; these parameters do not establish the statutory exception. From the current case, separately extract institutions expressly characterized as a school, college, or university; enrollment states with their exact student and institution; and regular-class-attendance states with their exact student and institution. Institution identity must be preserved so the unchanged program can test that enrollment, attendance, and employment concern the same institution. Use ongoing_since only for explicitly continuing wording, active_on_date only for an expressly dated status, closed_interval only with both endpoints, and onset_only when persistence is unsupported. Do not infer enrollment from attendance, attendance from enrollment, sameness from similar names, or clause applicability. Return all coherent views. Complete finite absence requires a nonempty current witness; unread or ambiguous extraction remains unread and may have no witness.

value.rationale: 四个合同都只学习事实表示与到作者原生谓词的确定性转换，不修改或复制法律程序。general_employer 具体复用既有付款/服务事件视图的付款人、收款人、金额、服务种类和期间，但新增“付款日期是否明示”以防把服务期冒充付款日，并通过独立的 service/payment 事件根修复原生读取中的角色混线。dependent_basic_deduction_limit 复用有向 section 151 given 的思想，新增年度收入和婚姻状态事件；正负 given 保持同一参数方向并分置 facts/negative_givens，年度收入才使用年度边界，且语义记录在转换时去重。surviving_spouse_death_window 复用 ongoing-state 表示并新增配偶死亡事件；ongoing_since 可无结束点，onset_only 不会被错误降为永久状态。student_service_exception 是无相关错误 episode 的新 source-only primitive，因此 parent=null、feedback=[]；它分别表示服务、教育机构、入学和上课，并保留机构标识，使原程序而非适配器检验是否为同一学校及工作日是否落在状态期间。所有适配器从实际 kernel.native_query 读取当前查询实体/年份/工作日来定位任务，但不把目标条款当作事实；complete 的有限记录或有限缺失必须有当前逐字 witness，unread 不产生绑定，所有连贯视图均保留为 alternatives。
